problem.problem_statement: Licensed claims adjusters wait too long for complete, evidence-linked intake summaries, contributing to an 18-hour median intake-to-assignment time, 22% intake rework, and incomplete audit evidence.
problem.business_owner: Elena Ruiz, VP of Claims Operations
current_workflow: Receive claim intake forms and supporting documents.
Verify policy, claimant, and loss details across systems.
Read documents and assemble a source-linked evidence summary.
Identify missing information and select a routing queue.
Record the rationale and assign the claim for adjuster review.
frictions: Evidence is fragmented across email, scans, policy systems, and the claims platform.
Intake summaries are written manually and vary by specialist.
Incorrect or missing intake information causes 22% rework.
Only 71% of audit records contain complete source citations.
non_goals: Autonomously approve or deny a claim.
Send customer communications or update the system of record without human approval.

decision_contract.decision: Choose whether to request evidence, continue review, or escalate the claim.
decision_contract.assistant_action: Present a source-linked summary, identify missing information, and recommend one allowed workflow action.
decision_contract.expected_outcome: Reduce intake delay and avoidable rework while improving citation completeness.
decision_contract.human_authority: A licensed claims adjuster approves, changes, or rejects every recommendation before any downstream action.

reasons: The workflow requires summarizing variable free text and semi-structured documents.
Recommendations can be evaluated against reviewed historical claims and cited sources.
A licensed adjuster remains accountable for the final claim decision and action.
deterministic_alternatives: Use field-level rules for completeness checks on structured intake forms.
Fix policy-document version metadata and improve the existing intake checklist.

sources.name: Claim intake forms
sources.constraint: Profile the 3% missing structured fields by claim type.

sources.name: Policy documents
sources.constraint: Normalize version and effective-date labels before retrieval evaluation.

sources.name: Adjuster notes
sources.constraint: Review abbreviations, sensitive text, and access rules.

gaps: Create a reviewed evaluation set representing claim types, missing evidence, and escalation conditions.
Resolve policy-document version and effective-date metadata before pilot ingestion.
security_constraints: Keep personally identifiable information inside Northstar's approved environment.
Exclude restricted fraud indicators from the first pilot.
Audit source retrieval, recommendation, human decision, and downstream action.

excluded_actions: Send customer communications or update the claims system.

owners.business_owner: Elena Ruiz, VP of Claims Operations
owners.data_owner: Priya Shah, Director of Claims Data
owners.technical_owner: Jordan Kim, Forward Deployed Engineering Lead

protected_actions: Send customer communications or update the claims system of record.

scale_gate.owner: Elena Ruiz, VP of Claims Operations
evidence_required: Quality results by claim type on a reviewed evaluation set.
Zero unauthorized protected actions and complete audit records.
Pilot targets for cycle time, rework, citations, and adoption.

risks.risk: The assistant cites the wrong policy version.
risks.mitigation: Normalize effective-date metadata and test retrieval by policy version.
Display source links, require an explicit adjuster decision, and review overrides.
Use approved hosting, least privilege, redaction tests, and audit logging.
Stratify evaluation and pilot samples by claim type and complexity.

discovery_exit_criteria.criterion: Business owner confirms the problem, baseline, and pilot scope.
User representative confirms the workflow and human approval boundary.
Data owner accepts the source inventory and remediation plan.
Security approver accepts the pilot data boundary and audit requirements.
Steering committee accepts measurable pilot targets and stop conditions.

recommendation.rationale: Proceed only with a bounded, human-approved pilot after policy-version metadata and the representative evaluation set are ready; do not authorize autonomous claim decisions or production scale-up during discovery.
prerequisites: Normalize policy version and effective-date metadata.
Build and approve a representative evaluation set.
Obtain Security approval for the pilot data boundary and audit design.
